title: docs(spec): name only the OpenAPI document where the retired /docs viewer page was named
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6zwDuV2XvoDkqC7bXgqnpc)_

Fixes #25121

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

`main` no longer serves the OpenAPI document's HTML viewer page (`GET {basePath}/docs`, retired by PR #25124, `1b3b65e64`). `registerRoutes` gates `registerOpenApiEndpoints` on `api.enableOpenApi`, and that registrar now mounts one route, `GET {basePath}/openapi.json` (`packages/rest/src/discovery-routes.ts`, read at `origin/main` `23540582f`). The spec text that still named the viewer now names the OpenAPI document only:

| Site | Before | After |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `rest-server.zod.ts`, `enableOpenApi` TSDoc | `openapi.json` plus "`GET {basePath}/docs` for a zero-dep Scalar-rendered HTML viewer" | the one endpoint, `GET {basePath}/openapi.json` |
| `rest-server.zod.ts`, `enableOpenApi` describe | "Enable OpenAPI 3.1 spec & docs viewer endpoints" | "Enable the OpenAPI 3.1 document endpoint (`GET BASEPATH/openapi.json`)" |
| `rest-server.zod.ts`, `documentation.enabled` tombstone prescription | "…leaves the `/openapi.json` document and its `/docs` viewer unmounted." | "…leaves the `/openapi.json` document unmounted." |
| `liveness/rest_api.json`, `enableOpenApi` evidence | "mounts both `/openapi.json` and the `/docs` viewer" | "mounts `/openapi.json`, the OpenAPI document"; `verifiedAt` restamped 2026-10-22 (call graph re-closed against `origin/main`) |
| `scripts/lib/openapi-self-consistency.ts`, rule 1 comment and the dangling-ref refusal | named "the Scalar viewer at GET /api/v1/docs" as a consumer | names the document at `GET /api/v1/openapi.json` and client generators |
| `migrations/entries/semantic/18.rest-api-config-dead-keys-retired.ts`, `replacement` and `acceptanceCriteria` | "the OpenAPI document and the docs viewer", "`GET /openapi.json` and `GET /docs` unmounted" | the OpenAPI document only, "`GET /openapi.json` unmounted" |

Regenerated: `gen:schema` (no tracked change), `gen:docs` → `content/docs/references/api/rest-server.mdx` (the two describe rows and the prescription row). One `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec`: `.changeset/25121-spec-openapi-viewer-prose.md`.

The `documentation.enabled` refusal is an accept-set no-op: same key refused, same issue path, same opening sentence; only its last clause changed. The two pins that read the prescription (`packages/spec/src/api/rest-api-config-dead-keys-retirement.test.ts` `DOCS_ENABLED_PRESCRIPTION` and `packages/rest/src/rest-api-config-dead-keys-refused.test.ts`) match up to "`api.enableOpenApi: false` is the switch", which the new text keeps, so neither needed a flip. Both are green below.

## Tests (at `32bfe10cd`, the final head)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0): Test Files 706 passed (706), Tests 21462 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/rest-api-config-dead-keys-refused.test.ts src/rest-docs-viewer-retired.pin.test.ts` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0): Test Files 2 passed, Tests 17 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0, all 14 artifacts up to date (it was red on `check:docs` before `gen:docs`).
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed (description, TSDoc, comment and prescription text only).

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `32bfe10cd` derived 111 commands; each was run with its exit code recorded before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: "111 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 110 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".

- 110 exit 0. Five first exited 3 (prerequisite not met: the lint/formula, client-react and objectql dists were unbuilt, and `check:exported-any` / `check:generated` had read a spec dist while a concurrent turbo build was rewriting it). They were re-run green after the builds.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3. It needs every workspace package built, and this worktree built only the spec, lint, formula, objectql and client-react closures. `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it in CI.
- Local-only families: `check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0. `check:dev-prereqs` exit 1, NOT MEASURED: it reports "the workspace is not built" (33 of 70 packages have no dist) and names no stale spec dist. That is the box's state, not a finding.
- CI-owned families (the farm, Test Core, Build Core, Build Docs, type-check lanes): this PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope by the claim and untouched: `ApiTestingUiConfigSchema` (`ApiDocumentationConfigSchema.ui`, `documentation.zod.ts`, viewer enum including `'scalar'`) and `OpenApiGenerationConfigSchema.uiPath` (`plugin-rest-api.zod.ts`, default `/api/docs`, echoed by `REST_API_PLUGIN.md`). Measured at `origin/main` `23540582f`, `git grep -w` outside `packages/spec`, the generated references and the changelogs finds no reader of either. `ApiDocumentationConfig` appears once, in a comment at `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts:3061`. `uiPath` appears once, as an unrelated local variable at `packages/rest/src/ui-routes.ts:79`. `RestApiPluginConfig` in `packages/rest` is its own interface (`rest-api-plugin.ts:94`), not the spec schema. The seat files these as their own card.
- The changeset `.changeset/25077-rest-docs-viewer-attr-escape.md` (already on `main`) describes a viewer fix to a page that has since been retired. It is release-owned input, so it is not touched here.
